active.objective: Prove Wallet Transaction UX integration readiness against the exact current FAE-testnet main: latest-main ancestry, full lab-specific regression, cross-lab integration gate, exact candidate review, and a serial pull request. Stop before merging into main.
active.authority_boundary: Stop before merging into main. Main merge changes canonical engineering state and requires explicit human authority. Also stop before release, production deployment, new spending, credentials, backend/consensus changes, wallet key-material changes, or destructive infrastructure.

secondary.objective: After an explicitly authorized merge and combined-main verification, bind the exact integrated revision to the authorized frontend deployment and verify public bytes/read-only smoke before declaring LIVE.
secondary.authority_boundary: Requires separate merge and deployment/release authority; no implicit production or release authority.
